title: In vivo detection of pathologic α- synuclein and TDP-43 in the skin and olfactory mucosa of a patient with Parkinson’s disease-like phenotype carrying the p.Thr272Serfs*10 GRN mutation
title_zh: 携带p.Thr272Serfs*10 GRN突变的帕金森样表型患者皮肤与嗅觉黏膜中原位检测到病理性α-突触核蛋白与TDP-43
abstract: Abstract We describe a patient carrying the GRN p.Thr272Serfs*10 mutation, who presented with parkinsonism at onset and later developed prodromal frontotemporal dementia, in whom seed amplification assay on olfactory mucosa and skin analyses suggest mixed TDP-43 and α-synuclein co-pathology, highlighting how combining these techniques could provide a comprehensive approach to investigate the underlying neuropathological process.
abstract_zh: 摘要：我们描述了一名携带GRN p.Thr272Serfs*10突变的患者，起病时表现为帕金森样症状，随后发展为前额颞叶痴呆前驱期。对其嗅觉黏膜和皮肤进行种子放大检测显示存在混合TDP-43与α-突触核蛋白共病理，强调将这两种技术结合可为研究其潜在神经病理过程提供全面方法。
